name: General Mass Balance
expr: Accumulation = In − Out + Generation − Consumption

name: Overall Mass Balance (Steady State)
expr: Σṁin = Σṁout

name: Component Mass Balance (No Reaction)
expr: ṁA,in = ṁA,out

name: Mass Fraction
expr: wᵢ = mᵢ/Σm

name: Mole Fraction
expr: xᵢ = nᵢ/Σn

name: Average Molecular Weight
expr: M̄ = Σ(xᵢMᵢ)

name: Mass to Mole Fraction Conversion
expr: xᵢ = (wᵢ/Mᵢ)/Σ(wⱼ/Mⱼ)

name: Mole to Mass Fraction Conversion
expr: wᵢ = (xᵢMᵢ)/Σ(xⱼMⱼ)

name: Density of Mixture (Ideal)
expr: 1/ρmix = Σ(wᵢ/ρᵢ)

name: Volumetric Flow Rate
expr: Q = ṁ/ρ

name: Mass Flow Rate
expr: ṁ = ρQ

name: Molar Flow Rate
expr: ṅ = ṁ/M

name: Degree of Freedom Analysis (concept)
expr: DOF = Unknowns − Independent Equations

name: Basis Selection (concept)
expr: choosing a convenient reference quantity, such as 100 kg feed, to simplify balance calculations

name: Tie Component Method (concept)
expr: uses a component that does not change across a unit to relate inlet and outlet streams

name: Percent Excess
expr: %Excess = [(Feed − Theoretical)/Theoretical] × 100

name: Percent Conversion
expr: %Conversion = (Reacted/Fed) × 100

name: Selectivity (Reaction)
expr: S = moles of desired product formed/moles of undesired product formed

name: Yield (Reaction)
expr: Yield = moles of desired product/moles of limiting reactant fed

name: Extent of Reaction
expr: ξ = (nᵢ − nᵢ₀)/νᵢ

name: Theoretical vs Excess Air (concept)
expr: excess air is the amount supplied above the stoichiometric (theoretical) requirement to ensure complete combustion

name: Overall Balance with Recycle (concept)
expr: balance drawn around the entire process including recycle, so the recycle stream itself does not appear in it

name: Recycle Ratio
expr: R = Recycle Flow Rate/Fresh Feed Flow Rate

name: Purge Stream (concept)
expr: a purge stream removes a fraction of the recycle to prevent buildup of inerts or impurities

name: Bypass Fraction
expr: f = Bypass Flow/Total Feed Flow

name: Overall Conversion (with Recycle)
expr: Xoverall = (Fresh Feed Reacted)/Fresh Feed

name: Single-Pass Conversion
expr: Xsp = (Reactor Inlet − Reactor Outlet)/Reactor Inlet

name: Inert Buildup in Recycle (concept)
expr: without a purge, inert concentration in a recycle loop increases indefinitely at steady state

name: Splitter Balance
expr: ṁin = ṁ1 + ṁ2 + ... (composition equal in all outlet streams)

name: Mixer Balance
expr: Σṁin = ṁout

name: Combined Feed Ratio
expr: CFR = (Fresh Feed + Recycle)/Fresh Feed

name: Purge-to-Recycle Ratio
expr: Purge Ratio = Purge Flow/Recycle Flow

name: Fractional Recovery
expr: Recovery = amount of component recovered in product/amount of component in feed

name: General Energy Balance
expr: Ein − Eout + Egen = ΔEsystem

name: Steady-State Energy Balance (Open System)
expr: ΔH + ΔKE + ΔPE = Q − Ws

name: Enthalpy Change (Sensible Heat)
expr: ΔH = mCpΔT

name: Enthalpy of Vaporization (concept)
expr: latent heat required to vaporize a unit mass of substance at constant T and P

name: Enthalpy of Reaction
expr: ΔHrxn = ΣΔHf(products) − ΣΔHf(reactants)

name: Mean Heat Capacity
expr: Cp,mean = (1/(T2−T1))∫Cp dT

name: Adiabatic Flame Temperature (concept)
expr: temperature reached when fuel is combusted with no heat loss, all reaction heat raises product temperature

name: Heat Duty of a Process
expr: Q = ṁCpΔT

name: Kinetic Energy Term (Flow)
expr: KE = ½ṁv²

name: Potential Energy Term (Flow)
expr: PE = ṁgz

name: Bernoulli Equation (No Friction)
expr: P/ρ + v²/2 + gz = constant

name: Extended Bernoulli Equation (With Friction & Work)
expr: P1/ρ + v1²/2 + gz1 + Ws = P2/ρ + v2²/2 + gz2 + hf

name: Heat of Combustion (concept)
expr: heat released when a unit amount of fuel burns completely

name: Reference State Method (concept)
expr: enthalpy is calculated relative to a chosen reference temperature and phase

name: Energy Balance on a Reactor
expr: Q = ṁCpΔT + ΔHrxn × ξ

name: First Law of Thermodynamics (Closed System)
expr: ΔU = Q − W

name: Specific Enthalpy
expr: h = u + Pv

name: Heat of Formation (concept)
expr: the enthalpy change when one mole of a compound forms from its elements in their standard states

name: Heat of Solution (concept)
expr: the enthalpy change when a solute dissolves in a solvent at constant temperature and pressure

name: Continuity Equation
expr: A1v1 = A2v2

name: Reynolds Number
expr: Re = ρvD/μ

name: Darcy-Weisbach Equation
expr: hf = f(L/D)(v²/2g)

name: Fanning Friction Factor (Laminar)
expr: f = 16/Re

name: Hagen-Poiseuille Equation
expr: ΔP = 32μLv/D²

name: Volumetric Flow Rate (Pipe)
expr: Q = vA

name: Pressure Drop (General)
expr: ΔP = f(L/D)(ρv²/2)

name: Hydraulic Diameter
expr: Dh = 4A/P (wetted perimeter)

name: Velocity Head
expr: hv = v²/2g

name: Total Dynamic Head (Pump)
expr: TDH = Static Head + Friction Head + Velocity Head

name: Net Positive Suction Head Available
expr: NPSHa = (Patm − Pvapor)/ρg + hs − hf

name: Superficial Velocity
expr: vs = Q/A (total cross-section)

name: Terminal Settling Velocity (Stokes' Law)
expr: vt = gd²(ρp−ρf)/18μ

name: Drag Coefficient
expr: CD = FD/(½ρv²A)

name: Pipe Parallel Flow Split (concept)
expr: flow divides among parallel pipes such that pressure drop is equal across each branch

name: Moody Chart Friction Factor (concept)
expr: friction factor determined from Reynolds number and relative pipe roughness

name: Equivalent Length of Fittings (concept)
expr: fittings and valves are converted to an equivalent straight pipe length for friction loss calculation

name: Pump Power (Hydraulic)
expr: P = ρgQH

name: Pump Efficiency
expr: η = Hydraulic Power/Shaft Power

name: Cavitation Criterion (concept)
expr: cavitation occurs when local pressure drops below the fluid's vapor pressure

name: Compressor Work (Isothermal)
expr: W = nRT ln(P2/P1)

name: Compression Ratio
expr: rc = P2/P1

name: Isentropic Efficiency of Compressor
expr: ηs = Wideal/Wactual

name: Multistage Compression with Intercooling (concept)
expr: total compression work is reduced by cooling the gas between compression stages

name: Fourier's Law of Conduction
expr: q = −kA(dT/dx)

name: Thermal Resistance (Plane Wall)
expr: R = L/(kA)

name: Heat Flux
expr: q″ = q/A

name: Conduction Through Composite Wall
expr: q = ΔT/ΣR

name: Conduction Through Cylindrical Wall
expr: q = 2πkL(T1−T2)/ln(r2/r1)

name: Critical Radius of Insulation
expr: rc = k/h

name: Steady-State 1D Conduction (No Generation)
expr: d²T/dx² = 0

name: Biot Number
expr: Bi = hL/k

name: Fourier Number
expr: Fo = αt/L²

name: Thermal Diffusivity
expr: α = k/(ρCp)

name: Lumped Capacitance Method (concept)
expr: valid when Bi < 0.1, treats a solid as having uniform temperature during transient heating/cooling

name: Conduction Shape Factor (concept)
expr: a geometric factor used to calculate conduction heat transfer for complex shapes

name: Contact Resistance (concept)
expr: additional thermal resistance at the interface between two solid surfaces due to imperfect contact

name: Thermal Conductivity (concept)
expr: a material property describing its ability to conduct heat, units W/(m·K)

name: Newton's Law of Cooling (Convection)
expr: q = hAΔT

name: Nusselt Number
expr: Nu = hL/k

name: Prandtl Number
expr: Pr = Cpμ/k

name: Grashof Number
expr: Gr = gβΔTL³/ν²

name: Rayleigh Number
expr: Ra = GrPr

name: Overall Heat Transfer Coefficient
expr: 1/U = 1/hi + Δx/k + 1/ho

name: Sherwood Number (Heat-Mass Analogy)
expr: Sh = kcL/D

name: Colburn j-Factor
expr: jH = St·Pr^(2/3)

name: Stanton Number
expr: St = h/(ρvCp)

name: Natural Convection (concept)
expr: buoyancy-driven flow where the Nusselt number is correlated with the Rayleigh number

name: Forced Convection (concept)
expr: heat transfer enhanced by an external means such as a pump or fan driving fluid motion

name: Free Convection Heat Transfer Coefficient (concept)
expr: h estimated from empirical correlations involving the Grashof and Prandtl numbers

name: Peclet Number (Heat Transfer)
expr: Pe = RePr

name: Graetz Number (concept)
expr: a dimensionless group characterizing laminar flow heat transfer development in a pipe

name: Stefan-Boltzmann Law
expr: q = εσAT⁴

name: Radiation Heat Exchange Between Two Surfaces
expr: q = σA1F1-2(T1⁴−T2⁴)

name: Emissivity (concept)
expr: ratio of radiation emitted by a real surface to that emitted by a blackbody at the same temperature

name: View Factor (concept)
expr: fraction of radiation leaving one surface that strikes another surface directly

name: Blackbody Radiation (concept)
expr: an idealized surface that absorbs all incident radiation and emits the maximum possible radiation at a given temperature

name: Kirchhoff's Law of Radiation (concept)
expr: at thermal equilibrium, a surface's emissivity equals its absorptivity

name: Radiation Shield Effectiveness (concept)
expr: placing a radiation shield between two surfaces reduces the net radiative heat transfer

name: Wien's Displacement Law
expr: λmaxT = 2.898 × 10⁻³ m·K

name: Gray Body Radiation (concept)
expr: a surface whose emissivity is independent of wavelength

name: Net Radiation Method (concept)
expr: an electrical-network analogy used to solve radiation heat exchange problems between multiple surfaces

name: Heat Exchanger Duty
expr: Q = UAΔTlm

name: Log Mean Temperature Difference
expr: ΔTlm = (ΔT1−ΔT2)/ln(ΔT1/ΔT2)

name: LMTD Correction Factor (concept)
expr: applied for multi-pass and cross-flow exchangers to correct ΔTlm from the counter-current value

name: Effectiveness-NTU Method (concept)
expr: relates heat exchanger effectiveness to NTU and heat capacity ratio, useful when outlet temperatures are unknown

name: Number of Transfer Units
expr: NTU = UA/Cmin

name: Heat Exchanger Effectiveness
expr: ε = Qactual/Qmax

name: Maximum Possible Heat Transfer
expr: Qmax = Cmin(Th,in − Tc,in)

name: Heat Capacity Rate
expr: C = ṁCp

name: Heat Capacity Ratio
expr: Cr = Cmin/Cmax

name: Overall Coefficient with Fouling
expr: 1/U = 1/hi + Rfi + Δx/k + Rfo + 1/ho

name: Fouling Factor (concept)
expr: additional thermal resistance from deposit buildup on heat exchanger surfaces over time

name: Counter-Current Flow Advantage (concept)
expr: counter-current arrangement achieves a higher ΔTlm than co-current for the same terminal temperatures

name: Shell-and-Tube Heat Exchanger Area
expr: A = Q/(UΔTlm)

name: Plate Heat Exchanger (concept)
expr: uses thin corrugated plates to achieve high heat transfer area per unit volume

name: Baffle Spacing (concept)
expr: baffles direct shell-side flow across tubes to enhance the convective heat transfer coefficient

name: Economy of Evaporator
expr: Economy = kg vapor produced/kg steam used

name: Boiling Point Elevation (concept)
expr: increase in the boiling point of a solution compared to the pure solvent, due to dissolved solute

name: Duhring's Rule (concept)
expr: plots the boiling point of a solution against the boiling point of pure water at the same pressure to estimate BPE

name: Single Effect Evaporator Heat Balance
expr: ṁsteam·λsteam = ṁvapor·λvapor + sensible heat terms

name: Multiple Effect Evaporator Economy (concept)
expr: economy approximately equals the number of effects in a multiple-effect evaporator system

name: Capacity vs Economy (concept)
expr: capacity depends on heat transfer area and ΔT, while economy depends on the number of effects

name: Forward Feed Arrangement (concept)
expr: feed and steam flow in the same direction through evaporator effects

name: Backward Feed Arrangement (concept)
expr: feed flows opposite to steam flow, useful for viscous feeds that thin as they concentrate

name: Vapor Recompression Economy (concept)
expr: mechanically recompressing vapor to reuse as heating steam, reducing external steam demand

name: Evaporator Capacity (concept)
expr: the mass of water vaporized per unit time from the feed solution

name: Relative Volatility
expr: α = (yA/xA)/(yB/xB)

name: Raoult's Law (VLE)
expr: pA = xAPA*

name: Modified Raoult's Law
expr: yAP = xAγAPA*

name: Fenske Equation (Minimum Stages)
expr: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1−xD))×((1−xB)/xB)]/lnα

name: Underwood Equation (concept)
expr: determines the minimum reflux ratio required for a specified separation

name: Gilliland Correlation (concept)
expr: relates the actual number of stages to the minimum stages and reflux ratio

name: Reflux Ratio
expr: R = L/D

name: Operating Line – Stripping Section
expr: ym+1 = (L'/V')xm − (B/V')xB

name: McCabe-Thiele Method (concept)
expr: graphical method using operating lines and the equilibrium curve to determine the number of theoretical stages

name: Feed Quality (q)
expr: q = (HV − HF)/(HV − HL)

name: Murphree Plate Efficiency
expr: EMV = (yn − yn−1)/(yn* − yn−1)

name: Overall Column Efficiency
expr: Eo = Ntheoretical/Nactual

name: Total Reflux (concept)
expr: operating condition with no product withdrawal, giving the minimum possible number of stages

name: Material Balance – Distillation Column
expr: F = D + B

name: Component Balance – Distillation Column
expr: FxF = DxD + BxB

name: Azeotrope (concept)
expr: a mixture whose vapor and liquid compositions are identical, so ordinary distillation cannot separate it further

name: Extractive Distillation (concept)
expr: adds a high-boiling solvent to alter relative volatility and enable separation of close-boiling mixtures

name: Azeotropic Distillation (concept)
expr: adds an entrainer that forms a new azeotrope to break an existing azeotrope

name: Steam Distillation (concept)
expr: uses steam to lower the effective boiling point of high-boiling or heat-sensitive organic compounds

name: Optimum Feed Plate Location (concept)
expr: the plate where feed is introduced so its composition most closely matches the plate liquid composition

name: Henry's Law
expr: p = Hx

name: Absorption Factor
expr: A = L/(mV)

name: Stripping Factor
expr: S = mV/L

name: Minimum Liquid-to-Gas Ratio (concept)
expr: the smallest L/V ratio that can still achieve the desired degree of absorption

name: Packed Column Height
expr: Z = HTU × NTU

name: Height of a Transfer Unit (Gas Phase)
expr: HTU = G/(KyaS)

name: Overall Gas-Phase Mass Transfer Coefficient
expr: 1/Ky = 1/ky + m/kx

name: Flooding Velocity (concept)
expr: the gas velocity in a packed column above which liquid is entrained and normal operation is disrupted

name: Pressure Drop in Packed Column (concept)
expr: increases with gas velocity and liquid loading, rising sharply near the flooding point

name: Wetted Wall Column (concept)
expr: a device used to study gas absorption where liquid flows as a thin film down a vertical tube

name: Distribution Coefficient
expr: KD = CE/CR

name: Extraction Factor
expr: E = KD × (Solvent Flow/Feed Flow)

name: Selectivity (Extraction)
expr: β = KD,A/KD,B

name: Single-Stage Extraction Balance
expr: F·xF = E·yE + R·xR

name: Countercurrent Extraction (concept)
expr: feed and solvent move in opposite directions through multiple stages to improve separation efficiency

name: Solvent-to-Feed Ratio
expr: S/F = mass of solvent/mass of feed

name: Extraction Yield
expr: Yield = amount extracted/amount originally present in feed

name: Ternary Phase Diagram (concept)
expr: used to represent equilibrium data for a three-component liquid-liquid extraction system

name: Tie Line (concept)
expr: a line on a ternary diagram connecting the compositions of two phases in equilibrium

name: Number of Ideal Stages (concept)
expr: determined graphically using a triangular or McCabe-Thiele-type diagram for extraction systems

name: Absolute Humidity
expr: Y = mass of vapor/mass of dry gas

name: Relative Humidity
expr: RH = (pvapor/psaturation) × 100

name: Percentage Humidity
expr: %H = (Y/Ysaturation) × 100

name: Humid Heat
expr: Cs = Cp,dry gas + Y·Cp,vapor

name: Dew Point (concept)
expr: the temperature at which air becomes saturated with water vapor upon cooling at constant pressure

name: Wet Bulb Temperature (concept)
expr: the temperature reached by evaporative cooling of a wet surface exposed to moving air

name: Adiabatic Saturation Temperature (concept)
expr: the temperature air reaches when adiabatically saturated with water vapor

name: Psychrometric Chart (concept)
expr: a graphical tool relating humidity, temperature, enthalpy, and specific volume of moist air

name: Cooling Tower Approach (concept)
expr: the difference between the exit water temperature and the wet bulb temperature of entering air

name: Cooling Tower Range
expr: Range = Water inlet temperature − Water outlet temperature

name: Makeup Water Requirement (Cooling Tower)
expr: Makeup = Evaporation Loss + Drift Loss + Blowdown

name: Lewis Relation (concept)
expr: relates heat and mass transfer coefficients in humidification operations for air-water systems

name: Enthalpy of Humid Air
expr: H = CsT + Yλ0

name: Humid Volume (concept)
expr: the specific volume of dry gas plus its associated water vapor, per unit mass of dry gas

name: Moisture Content (Dry Basis)
expr: X = mass of water/mass of dry solid

name: Moisture Content (Wet Basis)
expr: w = mass of water/total mass of wet solid

name: Critical Moisture Content (concept)
expr: the moisture content at which drying rate begins to fall below the constant-rate value

name: Falling Rate Period (concept)
expr: drying rate decreases as internal moisture diffusion becomes rate-limiting below the critical moisture content

name: Equilibrium Moisture Content (concept)
expr: the moisture content at which a solid neither gains nor loses moisture to the surrounding air

name: Drying Rate
expr: R = −(Ls/A)(dX/dt)

name: Bound vs Unbound Moisture (concept)
expr: bound moisture is held within the solid structure by physical/chemical forces, unbound moisture is free surface moisture

name: Rate of Drying Curve (concept)
expr: plot of drying rate versus moisture content, showing constant-rate and falling-rate periods

name: Freeze Drying (concept)
expr: removes moisture from a frozen product via sublimation under vacuum, preserving heat-sensitive materials

name: Spray Drying (concept)
expr: atomizes a liquid feed into fine droplets which are rapidly dried by hot gas to form a powder

name: Fluidized Bed Drying (concept)
expr: solids are suspended and dried by an upward-flowing hot gas stream, giving high heat and mass transfer rates

name: Langmuir Isotherm
expr: qe = qmKCe/(1+KCe)

name: Freundlich Isotherm
expr: qe = KfCe^(1/n)

name: Adsorption Capacity
expr: q = (C0−Ce)V/m

name: Breakthrough Curve (concept)
expr: plot of effluent concentration versus time/volume in a fixed-bed adsorption column, used to determine bed exhaustion

name: Mass Transfer Zone (concept)
expr: the region of an adsorption bed where the concentration profile changes from feed to effluent conditions

name: BET Isotherm (concept)
expr: describes multilayer physical adsorption of gas molecules on a solid surface, used to measure surface area

name: Regeneration of Adsorbent (concept)
expr: restoring adsorbent capacity by desorbing the adsorbed species, e.g. via steam or thermal swing

name: Pressure Swing Adsorption (concept)
expr: separates gas mixtures using adsorption at high pressure and desorption at low pressure

name: Selectivity of Adsorbent
expr: Selectivity = (qA/CA)/(qB/CB)

name: Breakthrough Time (concept)
expr: the time at which the effluent concentration first reaches an unacceptable level

name: Membrane Flux
expr: J = permeate volume/(membrane area × time)

name: Rejection Coefficient
expr: R = 1 − (Cpermeate/Cfeed)

name: Osmotic Pressure (Van't Hoff)
expr: π = MRT

name: Reverse Osmosis Driving Force
expr: ΔPeffective = ΔP − Δπ

name: Concentration Polarization (concept)
expr: buildup of rejected solute near the membrane surface, reducing effective flux

name: Membrane Selectivity (concept)
expr: the ability of a membrane to preferentially permeate one species over another

name: Ultrafiltration (concept)
expr: a pressure-driven membrane process separating macromolecules and colloids based on molecular size

name: Gas Permeation Through Membrane
expr: J = P(Δp)/l

name: Fouling of Membranes (concept)
expr: deposition of particulates or solutes on a membrane surface that reduces flux over time

name: Permeability Coefficient (concept)
expr: an intrinsic membrane property relating flux to driving force per unit thickness

name: Supersaturation
expr: ΔC = C − Csat

name: Nucleation Rate (concept)
expr: rate of formation of new crystal nuclei, strongly dependent on the degree of supersaturation

name: Crystal Growth Rate (concept)
expr: rate at which existing crystal surfaces grow, generally slower than nucleation at high supersaturation

name: McCabe ΔL Law (concept)
expr: all crystals of the same material grown in the same environment grow by the same increment ΔL, regardless of initial size

name: Metastable Zone Width (concept)
expr: the supersaturation range in which spontaneous nucleation does not occur, but existing crystals continue growing

name: Population Balance (concept)
expr: tracks the number distribution of crystal sizes as nucleation, growth, and dissolution occur

name: Coefficient of Variation (Crystal Size Distribution)
expr: CV = (σ/mean size) × 100

name: Solubility Curve (concept)
expr: a plot of solute solubility versus temperature used to design cooling crystallization

name: Mother Liquor (concept)
expr: the saturated solution remaining after crystals have been removed by filtration

name: Yield of Crystallization (concept)
expr: the mass of crystals recovered relative to the solute originally dissolved in the feed solution

name: Darcy's Law for Filtration
expr: dV/dt = ΔPA/(μRt)

name: Specific Cake Resistance (concept)
expr: resistance per unit mass of cake deposited, dependent on particle size and cake compressibility

name: Filter Cake Resistance
expr: Rc = αwV/A

name: Filtration Rate Equation
expr: dV/dt = ΔPA²/[μ(αwV + RmA)]

name: Constant Pressure Filtration (concept)
expr: filtration operated at constant pressure drop, filtration rate decreases as cake builds up

name: Constant Rate Filtration (concept)
expr: filtration operated at constant volumetric flow rate, pressure drop increases as cake builds up

name: Medium Resistance (concept)
expr: the resistance of the filter medium itself, before cake forms

name: Cake Washing (concept)
expr: passing wash liquid through the filter cake to remove residual filtrate/solute after filtration

name: Filtration Cycle Time
expr: tcycle = filtration time + washing time + cake removal/downtime

name: Rotary Vacuum Filter Capacity (concept)
expr: continuous filtration capacity depends on drum submergence, rotation speed, and pressure differential

name: Power Number
expr: Po = P/(ρN³D⁵)

name: Reynolds Number (Agitation)
expr: Re = ρND²/μ

name: Froude Number (Agitation)
expr: Fr = N²D/g

name: Mixing Time (concept)
expr: the time required to achieve a specified degree of uniformity in a mixed vessel

name: Impeller Power (Turbulent Regime)
expr: P = Po·ρN³D⁵

name: Scale-Up Criteria – Equal Power per Volume (concept)
expr: scale-up rule maintaining constant P/V between small and large mixing vessels

name: Scale-Up Criteria – Equal Tip Speed (concept)
expr: scale-up rule maintaining constant impeller tip speed, ND, to preserve shear conditions

name: Impeller Tip Speed
expr: vtip = πND

name: Baffles in Mixing Vessels (concept)
expr: baffles prevent vortex formation and promote turbulent, top-to-bottom mixing

name: Blend Time Correlation (concept)
expr: empirical correlations relate blend time to impeller speed, diameter, and tank geometry

name: Ergun Equation (Pressure Drop, Packed Bed)
expr: ΔP/L = 150μ(1−ε)²v/(ε³dp²) + 1.75ρ(1−ε)v²/(ε³dp)

name: Void Fraction (Bed Porosity)
expr: ε = Void Volume/Total Bed Volume

name: Terminal Velocity of a Particle
expr: vt = √(4gdp(ρp−ρf)/(3CDρf))

name: Minimum Fluidization Velocity (concept)
expr: the gas velocity at which the drag force on particles equals their effective weight, initiating fluidization

name: Fluidization Regimes (concept)
expr: bed behavior transitions from fixed bed, to minimum fluidization, to bubbling, to slugging, to entrainment as gas velocity increases

name: Sphericity of Particle
expr: ψ = surface area of equivalent sphere/actual surface area of particle

name: Sieve Analysis (concept)
expr: determines particle size distribution by passing a sample through sieves of decreasing mesh size

name: Sauter Mean Diameter
expr: d32 = Σ(niDi³)/Σ(niDi²)

name: Elutriation (concept)
expr: entrainment and carryover of fine particles from a fluidized bed by the gas stream

name: Bubbling Fluidized Bed (concept)
expr: gas in excess of the minimum fluidization requirement passes through the bed as discrete bubbles

name: Pneumatic Conveying (concept)
expr: transport of solid particles through a pipeline by a high-velocity gas stream

name: Angle of Repose (concept)
expr: the steepest angle at which a granular material can be piled without slumping, indicating flowability

name: Archimedes Number
expr: Ar = gdp³ρf(ρp−ρf)/μ²

name: Rate of Reaction
expr: −rA = −(1/V)(dNA/dt)

name: Rate Law (General)
expr: −rA = kCAᵃCBᵇ

name: Zero-Order Reaction
expr: CA = CA0 − kt

name: First-Order Reaction
expr: CA = CA0e^(−kt)

name: Second-Order Reaction (Single Reactant)
expr: 1/CA = 1/CA0 + kt

name: Half-Life (First Order)
expr: t½ = ln2/k

name: Half-Life (Second Order)
expr: t½ = 1/(kCA0)

name: Arrhenius Equation (Chemical Engineering)
expr: k = Ae^(−Ea/RT)

name: Activation Energy from Two Rate Constants
Elementary Reaction (concept)
expr: a reaction whose rate law can be written directly from its stoichiometry

name: Reversible Reaction Equilibrium (concept)
expr: at equilibrium, forward and reverse reaction rates are equal

name: Parallel Reactions Selectivity (concept)
expr: the ratio of rate constants for competing reactions determines the distribution of products

name: Series Reactions (concept)
expr: the product of one reaction step becomes the reactant for the next, with an intermediate concentration that rises then falls

name: Autocatalytic Reaction (concept)
expr: a reaction in which one product acts as a catalyst, causing the rate to increase before eventually decreasing

name: Michaelis-Menten Kinetics
expr: −rS = VmaxCS/(Km+CS)

name: Order of Reaction (concept)
expr: the sum of the exponents of the concentration terms in the empirical rate law

name: Rate Constant Temperature Dependence (concept)
expr: rate constants generally increase exponentially with temperature per the Arrhenius relationship

name: Batch Reactor Design Equation (Constant Volume)
expr: t = CA0∫(dX/(−rA))

name: CSTR Design Equation
expr: V = FA0X/(−rA)

name: CSTR Space Time
expr: τ = V/v0

name: Space Velocity
expr: SV = 1/τ = v0/V

name: Damkohler Number
expr: Da = (−rA0)V/FA0

name: CSTRs in Series (concept)
expr: a series of CSTRs approaches the performance of a PFR as the number of tanks increases

name: Mean Residence Time (Reactor)
expr: t̄ = V/v0

name: Conversion in a Single CSTR (First Order)
expr: X = kτ/(1+kτ)

name: Semi-Batch Reactor (concept)
expr: a reactor where one reactant is fed continuously while others are charged initially, useful for controlling exothermic reactions

name: Adiabatic Temperature Rise (Reactor)
expr: ΔTad = (−ΔHrxn)CA0/(ρCp)

name: Multiple Steady States in CSTR (concept)
expr: an exothermic CSTR can exhibit multiple stable operating temperatures for the same feed conditions

name: Levenspiel Plot (concept)
expr: a plot of 1/(−rA) versus conversion X, used to graphically size reactors from the area under the curve

name: Yield-Selectivity Reactor Design (concept)
expr: reactor type and operating conditions chosen to maximize yield/selectivity toward the desired product

name: Energy Balance on CSTR (concept)
expr: relates the heat generated by reaction to the heat removed and the sensible heat change across the reactor

name: PFR Design Equation
expr: V = FA0∫(dX/(−rA))

name: PFR Space Time
expr: τ = V/v0

name: Plug Flow Assumption (concept)
expr: assumes no axial mixing and a uniform radial velocity/concentration profile across the reactor

name: Residence Time Distribution (concept)
expr: describes the spread of residence times experienced by fluid elements passing through a reactor

name: Mean Residence Time from RTD
expr: t̄ = ∫t·E(t) dt

name: Variance of RTD
expr: σ² = ∫(t−t̄)²E(t) dt

name: Tanks-in-Series Model (concept)
expr: models non-ideal reactor flow as a series of N equal-sized ideal CSTRs

name: Peclet Number (Dispersion)
expr: Pe = uL/DL

name: Segregation Model (concept)
expr: assumes fluid elements do not mix with each other until they exit the reactor, each behaving as a mini batch reactor

name: Packed Bed Reactor Design Equation
expr: dX/dW = −rA′/FA0

name: Pressure Drop in Packed Bed Reactor (concept)
expr: calculated via the Ergun equation, affecting reactant concentration and conversion along the bed

name: Conversion in PFR (Second Order)
expr: X/(1−X) = kτCA0

name: First Law for Open System (Steady Flow)
expr: ΔH = Q − Ws

name: Second Law of Thermodynamics (concept)
expr: the entropy of an isolated system never decreases over time

name: Gibbs Free Energy (Chemical Engineering)
expr: G = H − TS

name: Helmholtz Free Energy (Chemical Engineering)
expr: A = U − TS

name: Fugacity Coefficient
expr: φ = f/P

name: Activity Coefficient (concept)
expr: a correction factor accounting for non-ideal behavior of a component in a liquid mixture

name: Van der Waals Equation of State
expr: (P + a/V²)(V−b) = RT

name: Compressibility Factor
expr: Z = PV/RT

name: Reduced Properties
expr: Tr = T/Tc, Pr = P/Pc

name: Corresponding States Principle (concept)
expr: fluids at the same reduced temperature and pressure exhibit approximately the same compressibility factor

name: Chemical Potential (concept)
expr: the partial molar Gibbs free energy of a component, driving mass transfer and phase/reaction equilibrium

name: Gibbs Phase Rule
expr: F = C − P + 2

name: Antoine Equation
expr: log10(Psat) = A − B/(C+T)

name: Ideal Solution (concept)
expr: a solution in which interactions between unlike molecules equal those between like molecules, obeying Raoult's Law

name: Excess Gibbs Energy (concept)
expr: measures the deviation of a real solution's Gibbs energy from ideal solution behavior

name: Equilibrium Constant from Gibbs Energy
expr: ΔG° = −RT ln K

name: Exergy (Availability) (concept)
expr: the maximum useful work obtainable from a system as it comes to equilibrium with its surroundings

name: Joule-Thomson Coefficient
expr: μJT = (∂T/∂P)H

name: Residual Property (concept)
expr: the difference between a real fluid's property and the corresponding ideal gas property at the same T and P

name: Third Law of Thermodynamics (concept)
expr: the entropy of a perfect crystal approaches zero as temperature approaches absolute zero

name: Partial Molar Property (concept)
expr: the change in a mixture's total property per mole of a component added, at constant T, P, and moles of other components

name: Raoult's Law (VLE)
expr: yiP = xiPi*

name: K-value (Equilibrium Ratio)
expr: Ki = yi/xi

name: Relative Volatility (VLE)
expr: αij = Ki/Kj

name: Bubble Point Equation
expr: Σ(KixFi) = 1

name: Dew Point Equation
expr: Σ(yFi/Ki) = 1

name: Flash Vaporization Balance
expr: F = V + L

name: Rachford-Rice Equation (concept)
expr: iteratively solves for the vapor fraction in a flash calculation given feed composition and K-values

name: Modified Raoult's Law with Activity Coefficient
expr: yiP = xiγiPi*

name: NRTL Model (concept)
expr: a local composition activity coefficient model used to predict non-ideal VLE behavior

name: UNIQUAC Model (concept)
expr: an activity coefficient model incorporating molecular size and shape as well as interaction energies

name: Azeotropic VLE (concept)
expr: at an azeotrope, x and y are equal, and relative volatility becomes 1

name: Henry's Law Constant (concept)
expr: a proportionality constant relating the partial pressure of a dilute solute to its mole fraction in a liquid at low concentration

name: Proportional Controller Output
expr: c(t) = c̄ + Kc·e(t)

name: PI Controller Output
expr: c(t) = c̄ + Kc[e(t) + (1/τI)∫e(t)dt]

name: PID Controller Output
expr: c(t) = c̄ + Kc[e(t) + (1/τI)∫e(t)dt + τD(de/dt)]

name: Offset in Proportional Control (concept)
expr: a sustained steady-state error that remains when only proportional control is used

name: Process Gain
expr: Kp = Δoutput/Δinput (steady state)

name: Time Constant (First-Order Process, concept)
expr: the time to reach 63.2% of the final response to a step input

name: First-Order Process Transfer Function
expr: G(s) = Kp/(τs+1)

name: Second-Order Process Transfer Function
expr: G(s) = Kp/(τ²s²+2ζτs+1)

name: Dead Time (concept)
expr: the delay between a change in input and the first observable response in the process output

name: Ultimate Gain (concept)
expr: the controller gain at which a closed-loop system under proportional control begins to sustain oscillations

name: Ultimate Period (concept)
expr: the period of sustained oscillation at the ultimate gain, used in Ziegler-Nichols tuning

name: Ziegler-Nichols Tuning (concept)
expr: an empirical method for setting PID parameters based on the ultimate gain and ultimate period of a process

name: Closed-Loop Stability Criterion (concept)
expr: a feedback control system is stable if all closed-loop transfer function poles lie in the left half of the complex plane

name: Feedback Control (concept)
expr: control action based on the measured deviation of the actual output from its desired setpoint

name: Feedforward Control (concept)
expr: control action based on measured disturbances, adjusting inputs before the output is affected

name: Cascade Control (concept)
expr: uses an inner control loop to quickly correct disturbances before they affect the primary controlled variable

name: Ratio Control (concept)
expr: maintains a fixed ratio between two process flow rates

name: Error Signal
expr: e(t) = Set Point − Measured Variable

name: Integral Windup (concept)
expr: excessive accumulation of the integral term when the controller output saturates, causing overshoot when the error changes sign

name: Bode Stability Criterion (concept)
expr: a system is stable if the phase lag is less than 180° at the frequency where the open-loop gain is unity

name: Gain Margin (concept)
expr: the factor by which the open-loop gain can increase before the closed-loop system becomes unstable

name: Rotameter (concept)
expr: measures flow rate by the vertical position of a float in a tapered tube, balancing drag and buoyancy against gravity

name: Pitot Tube Velocity
expr: v = √(2ΔP/ρ)

name: Thermocouple (concept)
expr: measures temperature via the voltage generated at the junction of two dissimilar metals (Seebeck effect)

name: RTD – Resistance Temperature Detector (concept)
expr: measures temperature from the change in electrical resistance of a metal, typically platinum

name: Bourdon Gauge (concept)
expr: measures pressure from the mechanical deformation of a curved, flattened tube under internal pressure

name: Control Valve Sizing Coefficient
expr: Cv = Q√(SG/ΔP)

name: Level Measurement by Differential Pressure (concept)
expr: liquid level inferred from the hydrostatic pressure difference at the bottom of a vessel

name: Sampling Rate (concept)
expr: how frequently a measurement is taken; must be fast enough to capture the relevant process dynamics

name: Flash Point (concept)
expr: the lowest temperature at which a liquid gives off enough vapor to form an ignitable mixture with air

name: Auto-Ignition Temperature (concept)
expr: the lowest temperature at which a substance spontaneously ignites without an external ignition source

name: Lower Flammability Limit (concept)
expr: the minimum concentration of a fuel vapor in air below which combustion cannot be sustained

name: Upper Flammability Limit (concept)
expr: the maximum concentration of a fuel vapor in air above which combustion cannot be sustained

name: Le Chatelier's Mixing Rule (Flammability)
expr: 1/LFLmix = Σ(yi/LFLi)

name: Relief Valve Sizing (concept)
expr: sized to vent excess pressure at a rate sufficient to prevent vessel over-pressurization during upset conditions

name: Fault Tree Analysis (concept)
expr: a top-down logical diagram tracing the combinations of failures that could lead to a specific hazardous event

name: HAZOP Study (concept)
expr: systematic examination of a process using guide words to identify potential deviations and their hazards

name: Layer of Protection Analysis (concept)
expr: a semi-quantitative method evaluating whether independent protection layers adequately reduce risk to a tolerable level

name: Vapor Cloud Explosion (concept)
expr: an explosion resulting from the ignition of a large flammable vapor cloud released into open air

name: BLEVE – Boiling Liquid Expanding Vapor Explosion (concept)
expr: a violent explosion from the sudden rupture of a vessel containing a superheated liquid

name: Maximum Allowable Working Pressure (concept)
expr: the maximum internal pressure a vessel is designed to safely withstand at a specified temperature

name: Inherently Safer Design (concept)
expr: a design philosophy that seeks to eliminate or reduce hazards rather than merely control or mitigate them

name: Total Capital Investment
expr: TCI = Fixed Capital Investment + Working Capital

name: Equipment Cost Index Scaling
expr: C2 = C1(Index2/Index1)

name: Total Product Cost
expr: TPC = Manufacturing Cost + General Expenses

name: Break-Even Point (Plant)
expr: BEP = Fixed Costs/(Selling Price − Variable Cost per Unit)

name: Payback Period (Plant)
expr: PBP = Fixed Capital Investment/Average Annual Cash Flow

name: Return on Investment (Plant)
expr: ROI = Annual Profit/Total Investment

name: Net Present Value (Plant Project)
expr: NPV = Σ[Cash Flowt/(1+r)^t] − Initial Investment

name: Depreciation (Straight Line)
expr: D = (Initial Cost − Salvage Value)/Useful Life

name: Depreciation (Declining Balance)
expr: D = Book Value × Depreciation Rate

name: Lang Factor Method (concept)
expr: estimates total plant cost as a multiple of the purchased equipment cost

name: Process Flow Diagram (concept)
expr: a schematic showing the major equipment, streams, and flow of a process, without full instrumentation detail

name: Piping and Instrumentation Diagram (concept)
expr: a detailed schematic showing all equipment, piping, valves, and instrumentation for a process

name: Rate of Return (Discounted Cash Flow, concept)
expr: the discount rate at which a project's NPV equals zero

name: Working Capital (Plant, concept)
expr: funds required to operate the plant, covering raw materials, inventory, and accounts receivable

name: Plant Overhead Costs (concept)
expr: indirect costs of running a plant not directly tied to a specific unit of production

name: Plant Capacity Utilization
expr: Utilization = Actual Output/Design Capacity × 100

name: Turnaround Time (Plant Maintenance, concept)
expr: the period during which a plant is shut down for scheduled inspection, maintenance, and repair

name: Installation Factor (concept)
expr: a multiplier applied to purchased equipment cost to account for installation labor, foundations, and piping

name: Chemical Engineering Plant Cost Index (concept)
expr: a widely used index for adjusting process plant costs for inflation over time

name: Vessel Volume (Cylindrical)
expr: V = πr²h

name: Contingency Allowance (concept)
expr: a percentage added to a cost estimate to account for unforeseen expenses and estimation uncertainty

name: Total Annualized Cost
expr: TAC = Annualized Capital Cost + Annual Operating Cost

name: Operating Cost Estimation (concept)
expr: includes raw materials, utilities, labor, and maintenance costs incurred during plant operation

name: Utility Cost Estimation (concept)
expr: the cost of steam, electricity, cooling water, and other utilities consumed by a process, often a major operating expense

name: Sensitivity Analysis (Project Economics, concept)
expr: examines how changes in key variables such as price or cost affect overall project profitability

name: Marshall & Swift Index (concept)
expr: a cost index used to update historical equipment costs to current values

name: Purchased Equipment Cost Estimation (concept)
expr: estimated from vendor quotes, cost curves, or correlations based on equipment capacity

name: Newton's Law of Viscosity
expr: τ = μ(dv/dy)

name: Power Law Fluid Model
expr: τ = K(dv/dy)ⁿ

name: Bingham Plastic Model
expr: τ = τ0 + μp(dv/dy)

name: Apparent Viscosity (concept)
expr: the effective viscosity of a non-Newtonian fluid at a given shear rate

name: Shear-Thinning Fluid (concept)
expr: a fluid whose apparent viscosity decreases with increasing shear rate

name: Shear-Thickening Fluid (concept)
expr: a fluid whose apparent viscosity increases with increasing shear rate

name: Yield Stress (concept)
expr: the minimum shear stress required before a Bingham plastic fluid begins to flow

name: Flow Behavior Index (concept)
expr: the n parameter in the power law model, indicating shear-thinning (n<1), Newtonian (n=1), or shear-thickening (n>1) behavior

name: Viscoelasticity (concept)
expr: material behavior exhibiting both viscous and elastic characteristics when deformed

name: Consistency Index (concept)
expr: the K parameter in the power law model, representing a fluid's resistance to flow

name: Octane Number (concept)
expr: a measure of a gasoline's resistance to knocking during combustion in a spark-ignition engine

name: Cetane Number (concept)
expr: a measure of the ignition quality of diesel fuel, indicating how quickly it ignites under compression

name: Fractional Distillation of Crude Oil (concept)
expr: separates crude oil into fractions based on differing boiling ranges within a distillation tower

name: Cracking (concept)
expr: breaks large hydrocarbon molecules into smaller ones using heat, catalysts, or both, to increase gasoline yield

name: Catalytic Reforming (concept)
expr: rearranges hydrocarbon molecular structure to increase octane number without changing carbon number

name: Hydrocracking (concept)
expr: cracking of heavy hydrocarbons in the presence of hydrogen and a catalyst to produce lighter, saturated products

name: Reid Vapor Pressure (concept)
expr: a standardized measure of a fuel's volatility at 100°F

name: True Boiling Point Curve (concept)
expr: a distillation curve showing the boiling point distribution of the components in a petroleum fraction

name: Petrochemical Feedstock (concept)
expr: hydrocarbon raw materials such as naphtha or natural gas liquids used to produce chemicals like ethylene and propylene

name: Sulfur Content Specification (concept)
expr: fuel quality standards limit sulfur content to reduce emissions of sulfur oxides

name: Biochemical Oxygen Demand (concept)
expr: the amount of dissolved oxygen consumed by microorganisms decomposing organic matter in water over a specified period

name: Chemical Oxygen Demand (concept)
expr: the amount of oxygen required to chemically oxidize organic and inorganic matter in a water sample

name: BOD Removal Efficiency
expr: η = [(BODin − BODout)/BODin] × 100

name: Activated Sludge Process (concept)
expr: a biological wastewater treatment process using aerated tanks with a suspended microbial culture to degrade organic pollutants

name: Food-to-Microorganism Ratio
expr: F/M = BOD loading/mass of microorganisms (MLVSS)

name: Air Pollution Scrubber Efficiency
expr: η = [(Cin − Cout)/Cin] × 100

name: Electrostatic Precipitator Efficiency (concept)
expr: efficiency depends on particle charge, collection area, and gas velocity through the device

name: Baghouse Filtration (concept)
expr: removes particulates from a gas stream by passing it through fabric filter bags

name: Flue Gas Desulfurization (concept)
expr: removes sulfur oxides from combustion flue gas, commonly using a lime or limestone slurry scrubber

name: Environmental Impact Assessment (concept)
expr: a systematic evaluation of the likely environmental effects of a proposed industrial project

name: Sludge Age (concept)
expr: the average residence time of microorganisms in an activated sludge treatment system

name: Landfill Gas Generation (concept)
expr: methane and carbon dioxide produced by anaerobic decomposition of organic waste in a landfill

name: Monod Equation
expr: μ = μmaxS/(Ks+S)

name: Specific Growth Rate
expr: μ = (1/X)(dX/dt)

name: Cell Doubling Time
expr: td = ln2/μ

name: Yield Coefficient (Biomass on Substrate)
expr: YX/S = ΔX/ΔS

name: Product Yield Coefficient
expr: YP/S = ΔP/ΔS

name: Oxygen Transfer Rate (Fermentation)
expr: OTR = kLa(C* − CL)

name: Batch Fermentation Growth Curve (concept)
expr: microbial growth in a batch culture progresses through lag, exponential, stationary, and death phases

name: Substrate Inhibition (concept)
expr: growth rate decreases at high substrate concentrations due to inhibitory effects, unlike simple Monod kinetics

name: Chemostat Dilution Rate
expr: D = F/V

name: Chemostat Steady-State Condition (concept)
expr: at steady state in a chemostat, the specific growth rate equals the dilution rate

name: Sterilization Design Criterion (concept)
expr: a measure of the extent of microbial destruction achieved during a batch sterilization process

name: Degree of Polymerization
expr: DP = Mn/M0

name: Number Average Molecular Weight
expr: Mn = ΣNiMi/ΣNi

name: Weight Average Molecular Weight
expr: Mw = ΣNiMi²/ΣNiMi

name: Polydispersity Index
expr: PDI = Mw/Mn

name: Glass Transition Temperature (concept)
expr: the temperature at which an amorphous polymer transitions from a hard, glassy state to a soft, rubbery state

name: Extent of Reaction (Step-Growth Polymerization)
expr: p = fraction of functional groups reacted

name: Free Radical Polymerization Kinetics (concept)
expr: proceeds through initiation, propagation, and termination steps, with rate dependent on initiator and monomer concentration

name: Extrusion (concept)
expr: a continuous process forcing molten polymer through a shaped die to form a product of constant cross-section

name: Melting Temperature of Polymer (concept)
expr: the temperature at which crystalline regions of a semi-crystalline polymer melt

name: Pool Boiling Curve (concept)
expr: a plot of heat flux versus excess temperature showing natural convection, nucleate boiling, transition, and film boiling regimes

name: Critical Heat Flux (concept)
expr: the maximum heat flux in nucleate boiling, beyond which film boiling causes a sharp temperature rise

name: Nucleate Boiling (concept)
expr: bubbles form at nucleation sites on a heated surface and rise through the liquid, providing efficient heat transfer

name: Film Boiling (concept)
expr: a continuous vapor film insulates the heated surface from the liquid, sharply reducing the heat transfer coefficient

name: Filmwise Condensation (concept)
expr: condensate forms a continuous liquid film over the cooled surface, adding thermal resistance to heat transfer

name: Dropwise Condensation (concept)
expr: condensate forms as discrete droplets rather than a film, giving a much higher heat transfer coefficient than filmwise condensation

name: Nusselt's Film Condensation Theory (concept)
expr: predicts the local heat transfer coefficient for laminar film condensation on a vertical surface

name: Subcooled Boiling (concept)
expr: boiling occurs at a heated surface while the bulk liquid temperature remains below saturation

name: Reboiler Duty
expr: Q = ṁ × λ

name: Condensation Heat Transfer Coefficient (concept)
expr: generally much higher than for boiling or single-phase convection due to the release of latent heat
